segments.title: The FIRST neck could barely turn
segments.say: The first neck ever could barely turn. About five degrees.

segments.title: Meet Tiktaalik
segments.sub: A fish with a neck, **375 million years** ago
segments.say: Meet Tiktaalik: a fish with a neck, three hundred seventy-five million years ago.

segments.title: Twists? NOT possible
segments.say: Sideways, about five degrees. Upward, about two. No big twists. The team modelled it with living sturgeon spines.

segments.title: So why a NECK?
segments.sub: To free the **shoulders** for front limbs
segments.say: So why have a neck at all? Probably to free the shoulders for the front limbs.

segments.title: From a Nature study
segments.say: Source: a Nature study by a Penn State team.
